detail.title: Automated Detection of Objective Misspecification in Complex Systems
detail.summary: Current research suggests that automated systems designed to maximize specific reward signals often suffer from objective misspecification when real-world complexity is high. Automated detection methods must account for the bottleneck where inquiry is limited by predefined reward structures rather than scientific openness.
